title: Racking Potatoes at Don Pratt's Farm — Jute Bags for Market
description: At the Pratt farm in Lower Brighton during harvest time, workers rack potatoes and fill jute bags for the market. They discard all rotten potatoes and culls, which are misshapen or substandard market potatoes. Courtesy of Donnie Pratt collection.
